The siblings say Colleen has disappeared for days at a time and once lived in the woods for two weeks -- and paid a homeless man to try to kill her -- in an attempt to make her family believe she was dead. They also claim Colleen has faked a heart attack, falsely accused a neighbor of rape and most recently told them she’s receiving treatments for cervical cancer -- which they believe is just another lie. Dr. Phil brings the sisters together in search of answers -- and a resolution. How does Colleen explain her erratic behavior? And, is she really suffering from cancer? Plus, Ann Marie and Jackie admit they have enabled Colleen over the years by giving her money and food and paying her bills -- can they learn to put their foot down and help Colleen get her life back on track?

Mary says she has found no evidence of her daughter’s health conditions and was horrified to learn that Lynn had created a crowdfunding website, asking for donations for medical expenses. Lynn insists she’s gravely ill and says it sickens her even more that her mother doesn’t believe her. The mother and daughter face each other for the first time in a year on Dr. Phil’s stage. Dr. Phil reviews Lynn’s medical records -- how does she explain the inconsistencies? And, how can Lynn find a return to health and start living again?

programme.title: WAS MORGAN MURDERED BY A STALKER?
programme.desc: In December 2011, 20-year-old Morgan was found dead in her bedroom of a suspected drug overdose. Authorities later ruled Morgan’s death a suicide, but her parents, Toni and Steve, say that they believe something far more sinister was at play. They claim that Morgan’s former friend and neighbor, Brooke, 18, and Brooke’s ex-boyfriend stalked and tormented Morgan in her final days and eventually killed her. Toni and Steve say they have home surveillance footage showing shadowy figures on their property on several occasions but does it point the finger at anyone in particular? Plus, Toni says she has enough proof to reopen the investigation into Morgan’s death but does she? Then, Brooke joins the show with her father, Jim, and faces off against her accusers. How does she answer to the allegations against her? Tune in and decide for yourself: Was Morgan murdered?

Ed claims Carie was a drunk who spiraled out of control, using drugs and attempting suicide in the weeks before her disappearance and left their home voluntarily. Dr. Phil delves into what made a 48-year-old mother walk out of the house without car keys, wallet, phone or coat on a cold December night!

programme.title: MISSING MOM: WHAT HAPPENED TO CARIE?

Carie’s daughter, Shelbie, says most of Ed’s leads have ended in wild goose chases. She says she is tired of Ed and his daughter, Lauren, lying and wants Ed to admit the truth about her mom’s disappearance.

programme.title: RACHEL LEIGH HUTSON STORY
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

Ryann says her mother is the liar and says she is only interested in speaking with Dr. Phil with hopes that he can get some sense through to her mother’s “thick head.” What happens when Dr. Phil presents Ryann with evidence that seems to prove her mom’s side of the story? Plus, Shannon wonders whether Ryann’s behavior is because she has never met her biological father. See what happens when Dr. Phil reveals he was able to find Ryann’s biological father.

Bailey says their romance is like no other love story you’ve ever heard, but the shocking thing is this stranger has never met Bailey, and she wants her to stop sending thousands of messages professing her love. Bailey’s mom, Ericka, says she’s lost her daughter to this fixation she has with this stranger, and she wants her daughter back. When Bailey finds out she will be sharing the stage with her mom, Bailey storms off because she says she hates her mom. Will she come back and talk to Dr. Phil?

She says she met Jasmine on social media eight months ago and that it was love at first post. She says they’ve been communicating day and night but have never spoken on the phone and have never met. When Dr. Phil first tried to talk to Bailey, she became insistent that her mother, Ericka, not participate in the show, and Bailey angrily walked off the stage. Bailey decided to come back to tell Dr. Phil she wants to meet Jasmine for the first time because she has something important to tell her. Will Dr. Phil allow Bailey to meet the target of her obsession?

The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? programme.title: Love and Coffee
programme.desc: The love is hot when Breanna meets coffee shop owner Malcom, but his fear of commitment might put it on ice.

programme.title: Da Neighborhood Dopemane
programme.desc: Struggling with his finances working as a mechanic, CrimMane chooses the dope track as his side hustle, until a client offers him a dangerous proposition.

programme.title: Don't Shoot
programme.desc: After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.

programme.title: Her Best Revenge
programme.desc: After a tragic death, five fraternity brothers reunite at a vacation home, while the shadow of a death from their past lingers over them. A mysterious figure begins to send them threatening messages. Their secrets and loyalties are put to the test and they must uncover the truth about what happened that night five years ago.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends - DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine - are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: Her Last Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Athena Hart thought she had seen every kind of broken soul, until Lucas Morningstar walked into her office. What begins as therapy quickly twists into a deadly game of obsession and revenge. With her marriage crumbling, her assistant missing, and her reputation on the line, Athena must confront the terrifying truth.q

programme.title: Kill em with a Smile
programme.desc: Happily married Jessica has accepted that she is going to die from a terminal illness, and isn't afraid of death. Her real fear however, is her husband Reginald falling back in love with his ex Rebecca, and stealing the life she built.

programme.title: The Barista
programme.desc: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into a every aspect of his life, and sabotaging his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life.

programme.title: Bee Hive
programme.desc: Three women face financial woes and look to dealing for local drug lord Zeus. Jealousy, intimidation, and greed set in, when Zeus sees that they are selling and pushing faster than he ever could and suspects they are cutting in on him.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Boyz for Life
programme.desc: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters. This action-comedy blends thrilling chases, unexpected romance, and heartwarming moments of unlikely friendship, proving that even in the face of international villainy, laughter and brotherhood can prevail.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert, but is hindered by her reckless mother Shonte. When the opportunity arises for both her and her mother to go, they're surprised to find out they have been invited to meet and greet with her favorite artist. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Lacee: Rise 2 the Top
programme.desc: After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

programme.title: Battered Emotions
programme.desc: Rasheada has accepted that her battle with breast cancer is inevitable but her spiritual fight is still as strong as ever. She continues her upbeat facade for friends and family, but is unsure how long it will be until she can no longer compete with her emotional life's journey. Her sister, Tara, and her best friend, Bunny, struggle with their own issues of inner demons and domestic violence, while trying to support Rasheada through her battle.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she's always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she's truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Deadly Squatters
programme.desc: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

programme.title: A Love Letter to the Beatles
programme.desc: This joyous, fan-funded documentary celebrates The Beatles' enduring legacy through the eyes of their global fanbase. Eight years in the making, it traces their journey from The Quarrymen to global icons, exploring how their music transcends generations and borders, uniting fans and offering profound meaning.

programme.title: A Deadly Friend
programme.desc: When Carmen meets a new friend at school named Magic, she helps raise her spirits and allows her to stand up for herself. When her single father Drew starts seeing the school principal, Magic convinces Carmen to disrupt their relationship, pulling the veil on Magic's sinister nature.

As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: American Greed

programme.title: Pump and Gun
programme.desc: Rick Dale, one of Pawn Stars' most popular experts, runs Las Vegas based Rick's Restorations, a family business that finds, restores and upcycles cool objects ranging from Cadillacs to Coke Machines. The before and after reveals of his work are always highlights, in part because of the history nuggets Rick Dale shares about each object, whether it's a barber chair or a gas pump. In this spinoff series, featuring the dynamic characters at Rick's workplace, viewers will watch a variety of objects be bought, bartered and transformed, learning the process of restoration -- how do you duplicate Coke machine red? Where can you find 1920's tires? A storyteller who works with tools instead of a pen, Rick shares when and why objects were invented, who used them and how fixing or transforming them changes their value.

In this spinoff series, featuring the dynamic characters at Rick's workplace, viewers will watch a variety of objects be bought, bartered and transformed, learning the process of restoration -- how do you duplicate Coke machine red? Where can you find 1920's tires? A storyteller who works with tools instead of a pen, Rick shares when and why objects were invented, who used them and how fixing or transforming them changes their value.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Tunnels
programme.desc: Setenta años después del final de la 2GM, cientos de kilómetros de túneles construidos por los nazis podrían seguir protegiendo los últimos secretos de Hitler. Mike y Luke buscan en complejos de túneles inexplorados que podrían contener las respuestas.

programme.title: Tuskegee Airmen: Legacy of Courage
programme.desc: Un especial de una hora. Robin Roberts explora el legado de los aviadores de Tuskegee, el legendario grupo de pilotos afroamericanos que sirvieron en la 2GM, revelando cómo estos guerreros del cambio ayudaron a acabar con la segregación en el ejército.

programme.title: Nazis on Drugs: Hitler and the Blitzkrieg
programme.desc: Nazi plot gave meth to WWII soldiers for invincibility, unearths history.

programme.title: Secrets in the Sky: The Untold Story of Skunk Works
programme.desc: Por primera vez en 75 años, Lockheed Martin abre las puertas de su hangar y revela Skunk Works, el programa secreto y la subdivisión de aeronaves ocultos al público. El fundador y líder Kelly Johnson reunió a un equipo de innovadores.

programme.title: A Distant Shore: African Americans Of D-Day
programme.desc: 1.2M African Americans served in WWII, 2,000 stormed Normandy beaches.

programme.title: D-Day: The Untold Stories
programme.desc: Presenta los acontecimientos clave de la invasión aliada de la Europa controlada por los nazis durante la 2GM y honra los diversos orígenes de todos los que sirvieron, incluidas las experiencias de afroamericanos, asiáticoamericanos, latinos y mujeres.

programme.title: D-Days In The Pacific: The Final Graveyard
programme.desc: The word D-Day, the military speak designation for a start of an amphibious attack, has become synonymous with the Normandy Invasion. But in reality, there were more than a dozen D-Days in the Pacific, many on the scale of Normandy, and one, Okinawa, even larger. In this three hour special, World War II specialists Lou Reda Productions will examine the sometimes disastrous, sometimes brilliant D-Days of the Pacific.

But in reality, there were more than a dozen D-Days in the Pacific, many on the scale of Normandy, and one, Okinawa, even larger. In this three hour special, World War II specialists Lou Reda Productions will examine the sometimes disastrous, sometimes brilliant D-Days of the Pacific.

programme.title: Mortars/WWII GIs' Personal Items/Native-American Arrows
programme.desc: R. programme.title: Monkey Business
programme.desc: A&E continues the original real-life series Shipping Wars, which follows independent shippers who have discovered that fortunes can be made by transporting items that traditional carriers won't touch. Each episode of Shipping Wars dives into the cutthroat world of these heavy-duty movers as they battle for the chance to transport the unshippable. The competition begins with uShip, the world's largest online auction house for independent truckers. From oversized loads and bulky packages to the truly bizarre, these shippers will haul anything if the price is right. From rookie haulers to seasoned veterans, no shipment is too big for these professionals to handle. Marc, Jarrett, Jennifer, Roy and his beloved cat Muffy are back, along with new cast members Chris and Robbie. One of the industry's most unique shippers, Chris's edge in the business comes from his truck, which runs off of a waste vegetable oil system that he invented himself. While he's on the road, his girlfriend and business partner Robbie books loads and maps out routes while taking care of her son, Carter. Don't let their age fool you, this South Carolina couple juggles parenthood, running a successful business, and taking care of their golden retriever, Gix, who is a permanent passenger on the road.

"Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

programme.desc: With nearly one-third of Alaska's communities lacking a police force, the state's crime rate is on a meteoric rise. programme.title: Real Life Starts Now
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Sisters In Death
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.desc: For nearly 50 years, enthusiasts from all over the world have flocked to the Barrett-Jackson collector car auctions, named America's No. 1 Attraction for Car Lovers in the 2019 USA Today Readers? Choice Contest. Widely regarded as a barometer of the collector car industry, the auctions have evolved over the years into world-class automotive lifestyle events where thousands of the world's most sought-after, unique and valuable automobiles cross the block in front of a global audience-- in person and on live national and international television. Barrett-Jackson produces The World's Greatest Collector Car Auctions? in Scottsdale, Arizona; Palm Beach, Florida; Mohegan Sun in Connecticut and Las Vegas, Nevada.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: The Quest

At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

Out of the white river goddess and the black evil god came out two eggs, one white and one black that produces one good twin, who the river goddess chose as her priest and one evil twin who the black evil god chose as his servant to commit atrocities in the land, the battle line has been drawn, which of these twins will win the battle of the good and evil?

programme.title: Going Bongo
programme.desc: Dr. Burger happily lands a job at the prestigious Beverly Hills medical centre in Los Angeles and his eager to impress his new boss. After attending a Gala arranged by his superiors, he “mistakenly” volunteers to go work in Africa for a month at an under resourced hospital. Leaving his fiancé behind, this American Doctor heads out to Tanzania to follow through with his promise.

programme.title: Scama O'Rama
programme.desc: Two friends, Charles and Nebu battle with survival in the city of Lagos, Nigeria and after searching and struggling to secure any meaningful paying jobs decide to create a fake insurance scheme to defraud unsuspecting victims. Their plan works until a friend reveals their plot to the authorities.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Neema, a successful accountant haunted by her past, seeks her missing sister Tabu with relentless determination, guided by a witch doctor. Her journey is fraught with trials—getting lost in a mystical forest, surviving a bus fire, and encountering Sabri, a teacher, and Farida, a bar owner who alternates between ally and adversary. In a remote village, Neema faces moral dilemmas and violent confrontations, uncovering shocking truths about Tabu’s abusive husband Frank. Their reunion is bittersweet as Tabu refuses to leave Frank. After he brutally attacks Tabu, Neema exacts revenge in a deadly showdown, leaving her broken and bleeding on a bridge. Themes of family loyalty, sacrifice, and violence paint a vivid picture of resilience and despair.

programme.title: Nairobi Half Life
programme.desc: A young, aspiring actor from upcountry Kenya dreams of becoming a success in the big city. In pursuit of this and to the chagrin of his brother and parents, he makes his way to Nairobi: the city of opportunity. He quickly understands why Nairobi is nicknamed Nairobbery as he is robbed of all his money and belongings and left alone in a city where he doesn’t know a soul. Luck, or the lack of it, brings him face to face with two groups of downtown crooks and he forms a friendship with a young small time gang leader who takes him in. Drawn into a new world of theft and violence, he still tries to pursue his dream of becoming an actor. Keeping the two worlds separate proves to be a contest for him as he struggles to survive in this unknown world called Nairobi.

programme.title: Times and Seasons
programme.desc: A young, rich girl falls victim to the ramifications of a dysfunctional family. Her father sends her sick mother packing on her way to do national service. Her choices leave her outside of her comfort zone after ending up with the ghetto's ring leader. Her exposure to the two worlds gave her revelations about her family and her own identity.

programme.title: Prato Frio
programme.desc: Erica, a 19-year-old young woman, lives a seemingly perfect life with her wealthy parents. But her world shatters when armed intruders break into their home and brutally murder her family. As she grieves, the truth comes to light â€” "Frozen Revenge" unfolds as a gripping psychological thriller exploring trauma, betrayal, and vengeance, set against the backdrop of modern-day Mozambique. A powerful story of a young woman who turns pain into a relentless pursuit of revenge.

programme.title: Kati Kati
programme.desc: When Kaleche, a young amnesiac, wakes up in the middle of the wilderness, she has no idea how she got there. She makes her way to Kati Kati, a nearby lodge, where she meets a motley crew of residents under the leadership of Thoma. As Kaleche strikes up a quick and intense friendship with him, she discovers that there’s a lot more to Thoma and the mysterious Kati Kati.

programme.title: Man of Gold
programme.desc: After inheriting his father's church, Miracle and his friend Tobias venture into the gold delivery business, only to have the gold stolen. Desperate to repay the debt, they hatch a plan to use the church.

programme.title: Ni Sisi
programme.desc: Ni Sisi portrays a typical Kenyan community: a harmonious muddle of tribes, intermarriages, and extended families who have lived and worked together all their lives. Then one day rumors begin to spread and suddenly mistrust takes hold. People are identified as belonging to a different tribe rather than by their identity as a person. With mistrust comes a sense of threat and fear, and old friends now turn on each other. In a matter of days, the bonds and alliances are severed just as it did in reality in 2008. They find themselves plunging into chaos, and it seems unstoppable and brutal. Is it possible to learn from old mistakes and has a once peaceful community another chance?

programme.title: Her Broken Shadow
programme.desc: Two anthropophobic women are struggling to write novels. Adongo lives in East Africa in the near future while Apio lives in a space city in the distant future. They look so alike that one has to be the other’s doppelganger. Both are hermits, estranged from their respective families, and are suffering from loneliness. When the boundary between their worlds collapses, they discover that each is the protagonist in the novel the other is writing. Each believes she is real and the other a fabrication, yet their histories indicate that they might be identical twins, and that one murdered the other. As they struggle to understand the nature of their existence, they fail to tell reality from fantasy, the past from the present, and they have to solve the murder each committed in her childhood to avoid a complete descent into madness.

programme.title: I Bwiza (Tenacity)
programme.desc: Gatoni Maya, a 23-year-old brave girl, is resolved to fulfill her deceased father's dream of making a living through arts. Together with her co-workers in an artist collective named I Bwiza, she fights the injustice against artists by confronting Myasiro, the owner of the company that sells their arts; all while taking care of her ailing mother’s treatment and her younger brother’s school fees.

programme.title: Minga et la Cuissinière

programme.desc: The story through the main character, Tamara, enables the viewer to get inside the lives of married ladies who live with the scourge of marital violence across the world and learn what makes them tick.

programme.title: Nkinzi
programme.desc: Nkinzi follows an eight-year-old girl who runs away from home and finds refuge in Kampala’s streets, where she meets Junior, a street-smart kid, and his sister Princess. Together, they face urban hardships and form a deep bond on their journey to reunite her with her family. This heartfelt film explores empathy, resilience, and the power of friendship, shedding light on child welfare and the enduring strength of hope and human connection.

programme.title: Funny Universe
programme.desc: Ese has a striking resemblance to Mrs. Bucknor's lost daughter, Mrs. Bucknor's protege Festus employs Ese to pretend to be Mrs. Bucknor's long lost granddaughter so he can steal all of her wealth.

programme.title: It's A Free Country
programme.desc: When a routine outing at work takes an unexpected turn, a group of young friends find themselves caught in the cross hairs of a ruthless politician and a mysterious assassin in a fast paced and high stakes race for survival.

programme.title: Live Connections: Runtown
programme.desc: "Get ready for a captivating experience with 'Soundgod' Afrobeats Artist Runtown and his band. In this one-hour special, follow Runtown, his talented dancers, and the dedicated film crew as they prepare for a spectacular live event in London.

programme.title: Cook Off
programme.desc: Single mother Anesu's life is turned upside down when her son enters her into a reality TV competition. A refreshing view of contemporary life in Harare, Zimbabwe, told through the lens of a classic romantic comedy.

programme.title: Our Tomorrow
programme.desc: Our Tomorrow" is a powerful drama set in Kenya, where the rapid acquisition of land by investors has left many without a home. The film follows the journey of Kim (David Ochiel) as he seeks justice for the murder of his father. With the help of his friends Dante (Kennedy Gitagia) and Ryan (Lad Mambili), they take on the powerful and ruthless land developer, Rose (Cynthia Bonareri). As the stakes get higher, the trio must navigate corrupt officials, dangerous thugs, and their own personal demons to uncover the truth and reclaim their land. "Our Tomorrow" will take you on an emotional journey as the characters fight for their rights and for a better future for themselves and their community. Will they succeed or will they become another statistic in the fight for land rights? "Our Tomorrow" is a story of hope, friendship and the determination to build a better future.

programme.title: Foods of Kenya Episode 4
programme.desc: Mwaniki Mageria travels across Kenya, immersing himself in diverse communities to uncover how traditional cuisine shapes cultural identity and daily life.

programme.desc: Richard Mwako runs his law firm with an iron hand. He demands the best from his associates and never hesitates to make decisions that he believes are in his clients' best interests.

programme.title: The 2 Pilots
programme.desc: The Comedy starring Kwadwo Nkansah and Richard Asante tells the story of two friends who in search of a life of wealth and luxury come up with several schemes to dupe unsuspecting individuals of huge amounts of money. However, fate soon catches up with them and they find themselves entangled in a complicated situation with law enforcement as an undercover police officer poses an another ‘big fish’ waiting to be duped and exposes them. Their only means of escape is to hijack a plane and they find themselves caught between being ‘free but dead’ or ‘alive but not free’. Though a comedy, the movie also addresses some serious issues in Ghanaian society like infidelity, corruption among others.

programme.title: Back From Jail
programme.desc: A man released from prison finds his wife about to marry his best friend.

programme.title: Lynn's Fate - Black Friday

programme.title: My Wife and I
programme.desc: Facing divorce, a married couple tries to give it one last shot - and find their bodies swapped. Will the magical (or cursed) switch bring them out of their slump?

programme.title: Nirau
programme.desc: After his release from jail, a reformed Drug Dealer and Enforcer named Waruguma, leaves his old neighborhood to build a new life. But his past catches up with him when his Son is kidnapped by a former rival, who is consumed by revenge for the loss of a loved one. When Waruguma returns to his neighborhood, he discovers there is a contract out on his life, signed by his old partner Sasamo. When Waruguma tracks down Sasamo, he's forced to fight through a group of hardened criminals seeking to claim the bounty on his head in order to save his Son. As Waruguma fights he begins to wonder, is Sasamo his true enemy? Or is there someone else behind the scenes pulling the strings? One thing is certain, Waruguma must to learn to trust in his Ancestors, his wife, and his own instincts if he is to survive.

programme.title: The Herbert Macaulay Affair
programme.desc: The Herbert Macaulay Affair is a story that follows Young Herbert who returns from England and begins the opposition to the colonial government In 1898, Herbert is done with his scholarship training and becomes the first Engineer and Surveyor in the colony. Upon his return he is employed by the Colonial Government in Lagos He faces a lot of discrimination and watches it being done to fellow Lagosians. Annoyed by the constant marginalization, Herbert quits his job with the colonial government and starts a long opposition to them. He meets a beautiful woman Caroline Pratt who he falls madly in love with and unfortunately loses her to death during childbirth. Herbert is devastated and when he emerges from that darkness he delves more into fighting for independence. Our film catalogues a series of historical events which ends with him going to England to represent the Oba at the Privy council despite the colonial government doing everything to stop him. Car chases, Intrigues, schemes, nationalism and family are all part of this intense 90 minutes movie William Benson plays the Title character Herbert Macaulay. A veteran actor of many theatrical performances. He is well-beloved by a lot of Nigerians mostly because of his role as General Ape in the critically-acclaimed primetime drama Ajoche. He has garnered a cult following and delivers an Oscar-worthy performance in our film The Herbert Macaulay Affair

But his past catches up with him when his Son is kidnapped by a former rival, who is consumed by revenge for the loss of a loved one. When Waruguma returns to his neighborhood, he discovers there is a contract out on his life, signed by his old partner Sasamo. When Waruguma tracks down Sasamo, he's forced to fight through a group of hardened criminals seeking to claim the bounty on his head in order to save his Son. One thing is certain, Waruguma must to learn to trust in his Ancestors, his wife, and his own instincts if he is to survive.

programme.title: Salute!
programme.desc: Carlito is sentenced to five years in jail, leaving his pregnant girlfriend, Julia, on her own. In jail, he meets with the General and his crew. They lure him with food and gifts. One day, however, the General asked him to pay him back with sex. When Carlito refuses, they cut his food supply. Soon, Carlito begs for help again, and gives in to the General request. Meanwhile, his son is born, but he refuses to see him as he doesn't want his child to have an image of his dad in jail. Years pass, and Carlito become part of the General's gang, developing feelings for the General. Five years later, it is time for him be released. Julia had been waiting for him, and he meets his son. He resumes his relationship with Julia. When she falls pregnant with their second child, she discovers she is HIV+. She then confronts Carlito, who confesses about what really happened in jail, but too late.

programme.title: Katutura
programme.desc: Katutura follows a group of characters experiencing the gravity of living in a township. Ex-convict Dangi has to deal with living a law-abiding life, an extramarital son and an old flame who his wife doesn’t know about. Gangster Shivago explores a new market to sell his drugs and Kondja, a teenager in a wheelchair who helps street kids, falls in love for the first time. Their paths intertwine and their lives collide in both hopeful and brutal ways. Katutura deals with the struggle of everyday life in the township. There is crime, drug abuse, violence, but it also shows the strength of the community as well as the bustling creativity in the place otherwise known as the place where we do not belong.

programme.title: Nairobi Half Life
programme.desc: A young, aspiring actor from upcountry Kenya dreams of becoming a success in the big city. In pursuit of this and to the chagrin of his brother and parents, he makes his way to Nairobi: the city of opportunity. He quickly understands why Nairobi is nicknamed Nairobbery as he is robbed of all his money and belongings and left alone in a city where he doesn’t know a soul. Luck, or the lack of it, brings him face to face with two groups of downtown crooks and he forms a friendship with a young small time gang leader who takes him in. Drawn into a new world of theft and violence, he still tries to pursue his dream of becoming an actor. Keeping the two worlds separate proves to be a contest for him as he struggles to survive in this unknown world called Nairobi.

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: Black Widow is a story about gender exploitation. A cautionary tale about one woman's journey to self redemption and a wake up call to the events that led to her incarceration for murder.

programme.title: Rise of the Phoenix
programme.desc: Held captive by her extended family after the demise of her father, Ajabu Sarori Olailepo, 10, must choose between following through with bizarre community ritual of female genital mutilation or try to escape it all. In the burial of her late father, her mother; who is from another community, is chased away and Ajabu coerced into staying back in the village so as to undergo a procedure that will make her a woman. She however witnesses her cousin pass on following the same procedure and Ajabu makes efforts to escape the fatal act who in turn has to back on her curiosity, overactive imagination and determination to find her dispelled mother who has always been the model woman for her and beacon of hope, unaware that the same act is also practiced in her mother’s community. Her course and journey proves an ordeal as well as she faces in extremis experiences that consequently serve to make her a stronger young woman.

programme.title: Thandi
programme.desc: A girl falls in love with a married man she gets pregnant and she gets dumped. She then decides to leave her young baby near a clinic. Sibiya adopts the child, later on Mr. Sibiya falls in love with the biological mother of the child without knowing. After Mr. Sibaya passes away, Connie decides to make the child a prostitute without knowing its the child she dumped years ago.

programme.title: Kukro
programme.desc: A young hunter Ubadu lived in his 'Deadland', Kukro. Nothing he did in that land succeeded. One day, while he was hunting, he had an encounter with the gods which turned his life around. However, he broke the laws of the gods and he was going to die for his sin. He then pleaded that the gods spare his life and make his descendants pay for his sins. Many hundred years have gone by and from each of the generations that came after him, the gods picked one person to bear the mark of the curse.

programme.title: Wheel and Deal
programme.desc: Addicted to the desire for this pleasurable life leads a retired Marine Corps to plot a scheme along with a computer genius on how to get rich regardless of those involved. A one million dollars life insurance policy is his initiative and his children;Georgia, Kelvin and Regina are his beneficiaries including his grandchildren (Ben Jr & Benita). To receive the money once he’s dead, he carries on his first plan. He and his felon partner who happens to be a genius in hijacking, infiltrate the health system, pose as the personal to Kels by creating a terminal disease that Kels (this Ex-Marie Corps) suffers from.

programme.title: Demon Inside
programme.desc: Raped and scarred by her gynaecologist, Dr. Kyle. Evi seeks justice and vengeance on this rapist on the prowl that may go Scot free like other abusers. But with Kyle's license revoked and sent to prison, all is not fair until the DEMON INSIDE surfaces.

programme.title: Turning Tables
programme.desc: OSAHON OSUNIDE, a successful divorce attorney finds himself in a forbidden affair with one of his clients DIANE JACOBS who is going through a bad divorce However, Diane’s old school sweetheart finds his way back into her life. This throws Osahon’s world upside down as he begins obsessing over Diane which leads to a series of unfortunate events

programme.title: Rishai
programme.desc: Nyakio finds herself consumed by depression and overwhelming guilt following the tragic drowning of her son. Her despair reaches a breaking point, leading her to contemplate taking her own life. With a noose around her neck as she is about to surrender to the darkness, Jay, a tough debt collector working for a local loan shark, storms into her home. Nyakio owes money and he’s come to collect. Fate brings these two disparate souls together, forcing them to share an unexpected weekend. As they reluctantly share this time, Nyakio gradually realizes that Jay carries his own profound emotional wounds, which bear a surprising resemblance to her own. Through their shared experiences and unforeseen misadventures, Nyakio and Jay unwittingly heal each other along the way and get within the grasp of finding hope and a will to live.

programme.title: Leaking Womb
programme.desc: LEAKING WOMB a story of Yaya and Pete[a brother and a sister] who lost their child Hilda into a barren society that is in dire need of a child after being cursed by their father who termed their relationship as a taboo.The curse was to make them not to completely remember anything for two years.They are chased out of their homestead .A Sterile man[Mavuli] picks the child[Hilda] by the road and sells her to a couple[Kasisi and Velma] who are in need of a child too.Yaya and Pete become street children who are later helped by a good samaritan Mzee Tela.Mzee Tela passes on sending Yaya and Pete back to the streets of Nakuru.Kasisi employees Yaya as a houseboy to take care of the child as he helps his sister in the streets.The child goes missing in his hands.Kasisi tells Yaya to find the child and bring her back or else he stands losing his life.Yaya and Pete brings the child back but she is taken again in the presence of Kasisi for failing to clear the balance he had for the child.Yaya struggles to bring his sister to live with them.Kasisi chases Velma .He rapes Pete and marries her to get another child.Yaya and Pete plots ways to kill Kasisi for killing Mzee Tela and mistreating them.its later understood that Kasisi is Pete's father when a woman [her mother] who was mistreating her in the streets come begging for a job.

programme.title: Kapana
programme.desc: George, insurance broker, openly gay in a country where sodomy is still a crime, meets Simeon in a bar. The following day, they accidently meet again at Simeon's work place. Simeon is a Kapana seller (kapana is the local name for barbecued meet). George realises Simeon is in the closet. They keep seeing each other at the market. George then discovers that Simeon also plays soccer and is in the same team as his brother. They start meeting regularly. Simeon even accidentally meets George's family. Everything seems to go well, until Simeon realises George is on ARV. He feels betrayed George has never shared his status before and they break up. While Simeon drinks and tries one night stand with other guys, George gets depressed. Windhoek being a small city, they eventually meet again. In the end Simeon's sister, a nurse, help him understand that he can be with someone who is HIV positive and takes his ARV. Simeon goes back to George, apologising for his behaviour.

programme.title: Mono
programme.desc: "Young students arrive at the prestigious Francis Morris Morton Mission High School (Framomo) to join Form One. Their parents believe that this is the right school to turn their sons into men. As the boys discover a deep and sinister rot in the school, they try to fight for their voice, but it could cost them more than they are willing to sacrifice. Will Oliver and his friends survive Framomo?"

programme.title: Ndoto Za Elibidi
programme.desc: NDOTO ZA ELIBIDI was devised originally as a stage play for actors from the Nairobi slums. The story pivots around the theme of acceptance and love as its colorful protagonists – parents, four daughters and their lovers – come to terms with HIV and ghetto life. Cutting back and forth from fiction to documentary, from the original stage play to the actual locations, it takes us on two parallel journeys: we watch the story, but we are also watching it through the eyes of the ghetto audience.

programme.title: Dear Bayo
programme.desc: The film is a love story between a youth corper Bayo and a girl he meets Ebipade. Both from humble backgrounds are smitten by each other but to have to overcome difficulties in their personal lives to be together.

programme.title: Siyabonga (We Are Thankful)
programme.desc: Siyabonga (english title: We Are Thankful), named after the films main character Siyabonga Majola, is a docufiction film set in the KwaZulu Natal region of modern day South Africa. It makes use of footage from both the narrative and documentary tradition. In the film we follow Siyabonga, a young man making theatre plays in the township of Mphopomeni. One day he hears the surprising news that a movie is to be made in a nearby town and he makes it his mission to be part of the film. From conspiring with a maid to steal wifi from the umlungus (white people) so he can write an email to the film producers, to rebuffing a friend’s urgent plea for him to improve his luck through witchcraft, Siyabonga's journey takes him down many surprising paths that ultimately lead him to meeting with the film's director. Here we observe the conversation that caused the film we are watching to come into existence. A film based on real events, re-enacted by those who lived through them, we follow this extraordinary man as he does all he can to try and improve his life and take control of his fortune. Siyabonga's past echoes in his present in much the same way that South Africa's own history seems to have left an indelible mark on the people and places of the film. Time moves differently in such spaces. Places are never confined to just the here and now, but rather some kind of eternal memory.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E05
programme.desc: Bubba, Booger and Cody take an important step toward becoming big-time cattle brokers! The guys are roping and doctoring yearlings on the Texas range. But when Booger's most reliable horse Studly trips, smashing both horse and rider to the ground, Booger must rush out to find a vet and tend to his injured horse. Just as the cowboys are about to leave Texas, a local rancher makes them an offer they can't refuse. Will the guys gamble on a cattle deal, taking on a herd before they have a buyer lined up? Back home in Alabama, Kaley's patience reaches a breaking point as houseguest Andrew tracks in mud and expects a free lunch. To top it off, he then asks if his whole family can crash there while he searches for a permanent residence. Misty finds some extra help with her troublesome barrel-racing horse. Booger and Matthew are on the hunt for the perfect one-year anniversary gift for Jaclyn. But Booger may have a special surprise up his sleeve.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E13
programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Hollow Rock, Wyoming to attend the 4th of July horse race. In the town, he gets swindled in a card game by a corrupt sheriff who has him beaten, robbed, and thrown in jail. Bret's forced to enter the race to get his money back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E13
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns the body of war hero Cole Prescott to his hometown of White River for a proper burial. However, when Cheyenne arrives, instead of a warm welcome, the townspeople greet him with hate towards the dead man.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E01
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns to his hometown as Sheriff Bodie. He is seeking a murderer in a town filled with corruption. Being home brings back many memories, including an old feud and a man who organized a lynching when he was a child.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E28
programme.desc: Clarence Bibs, a simple-minded man, fancies himself as a gunfighter. While practicing, he falls and his gun fires, killing a famous gunslinger. The man's partner comes to town wanting revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E29
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark go on a hunting trip and soon become witnesses to a robbery and murder. Lucas subdues the two robbers, but is severely wounded in the process. Lucas struggles to get the robbers to justice, but devises a plan just in the nick of time.

programme.title: Maverick_S05_E06.mp4 (Segment 1)
programme.desc: No program description

programme.title: Maverick - S03 E22
programme.desc: Bret Maverick wins a massive sheep herd in a poker game from a rancher named Big Coley. However, the sheep are located on territory in the middle of a violent range war. When the cattlemen want his sheep gone, Bret finds a way to fight back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E06
programme.desc: Sioux brave White Crow needs medical help for his sick wife, Little Fawn. Cheyenne and Doc Farnsworth leave to go see her. When White Crow returns with gold as payment to heal her, the locals want to invade Sioux territory, possibly starting a war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E22
programme.desc: Julia Andueza opens a boarding house in North Fork. Lucas remembers her as a dishonest card dealer from the past. Her old boss arrives and tries to bully Julia into turning her business into a gambling house. Lucas realizes she has changed her ways.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E23
programme.desc: Lucas' life is in danger after he agrees to testify in a murder case in another town. The only other witness was killed, and when a gun-toting stranger appears at the McCain Ranch, Lucas now finds himself in grave danger.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E06
programme.desc: Bret Maverick travels to Mexico to find a man wanted for murder, then bring him back to New Orleans. He soon finds the supposed killer, a bartender named Steve Corbett. The two become friends, but only after Bret believes in his innocence.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S02 E11
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E01
programme.desc: Unable to apprehend the train-robbing Smith Brothers, Sheriff Doc Shores calls the Pinkerton Detective Agency for assistance. The agency sends Charles Siringo, an undercover specialist known for his unorthodox methods of capturing criminals.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E03
programme.desc: As a member of Lewis and Clark's Corps of Discovery, John Colter travels from the Missouri River all the way to the Pacific Ocean, but he decides not to return to the civilized East when the expedition ends. Entranced by the beauty and adventure of the wild frontier, he becomes one of America's first mountain men. As a hunter, trapper and explorer in his own right, he's the first American to see the Grand Tetons and the epic Yellowstone Valley. While his epic explorations make him famous, it's a harrowing ordeal with Blackfeet warriors that makes him a legend. After boldly venturing into territory controlled by the Blackfeet tribe, Colter is captured, stripped naked, and forced to run for his life as warriors give chase in what will come to be known as Colter's Run.
